hero.title: Rebirth with Aegean Breezes
hero.description: A unique life awaits you in Hebil, one of Bodrum's most special bays crowned with blue, opening to the azure sea with its own pier and beach. Combining nature's tranquil rhythm with modern comfort, Hebil Blue stands out with its elegant modern architecture, carefully selected natural materials, and timeless aesthetic understanding. While offering spaciousness and elegance together in your living spaces with its simple luxury concept, it adds value to the future with its sustainable solutions that provide energy efficiency.
hero.description_short: A prestigious project consisting of 80 modern structures in Bodrum Hebil Bay, just steps from the sea. It offers a unique lifestyle with its commanding position over the Aegean blue and private pier. A peaceful environment close to social life but immersed in nature.

banner.title: hebil blue hotel
banner.description: With its simple luxury concept, it offers spaciousness and elegance together in your living spaces; while adding value to the future with its sustainable solutions that provide energy efficiency.

banner_2.title: hebil blue hotel
banner_2.description: Silence, Elegance and a World-Class Living Experience The unique nature and architecture of Hebil Blue will soon be crowned with the signature of a world-renowned prestigious brand. Standing out with its flawless service understanding, sophisticated design, and timeless luxury, this brand will offer a prestigious destination designed for privileged guests in Bodrum's most special bay. The countdown has begun for this exclusive living experience.

verandalar: VERANDAS, FIRE PITS AND INNER GARDENS...
verandalar_description:
Spacious and airy verandas, stylish fire pits, and carefully crafted inner gardens are designed to make every moment special and add aesthetic value to your life.
While every detail inspires you to collect memories that will be etched in your mind, the landscape shaped with imported plants offers refined naturalness. The advanced technology lighting systems that elegantly envelop the night perfectly complete the magic of the atmosphere.
zamansiz_mimari_description: Every detail in Hebil Blue is designed to provide the highest level of elegance and comfort. Spacious verandas opening to panoramic views, special seating areas enriched with fire pits, and inner gardens integrated with landscaping add value to every moment and aesthetics to every glance. These unique living spaces immersed in nature come together with the clean lines of modern architecture and premium material selection, offering a new definition of privilege. Each of the 80 modern structures is equipped with its own pool, private garden, and living spaces that create a fascinating atmosphere at every hour of the day.
kullanim_alani_description_1: Hebil Blue is designed to suit different lifestyle preferences.
kullanim_alani_description_2: 42 Type A units offer wider and more versatile living spaces with 6+1 and 5+2 options, while 38 Type B units offer comfort and functionality together with a 5+1 plan. Each structure is equipped with its private garden, pool, and spacious verandas, as well as refined details and high-quality materials.
kullanim_alani_description_3: Type A has a total of 3 parking spaces, 2 covered and 1 open, while Type B has 1 covered and 1 open parking space.
kullanim_alani_description_4: This way, a perfect living space is offered not only visually but also functionally.
doga_description_1: Hebil Blue is not just a living space; it is a special life experience with every detail carefully considered, offering enjoyment in all four seasons. You can start your day with a peaceful walk, enjoy the sea from the private pier, and then relax at the spa center.
doga_description_2: The facility includes: Restaurant & Snack Bar, Fitness & Spa areas, walking trails & children's playgrounds, tennis court and basketball court, electric vehicle charging stations, indoor and outdoor parking, buggy service, gardening & cleaning services, seawater desalination system, sea taxi, hotel-comfort service approach and 24/7 security.

kvkk.title: Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK) Disclosure Text
kvkk.description: This Disclosure Text has been prepared for the purpose of informing users who visit the website ("Site") of the Hebil Blue project about the collection, processing, storage, and protection of their personal data within the scope of the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK").

dataController.title: 1. Data Controller
dataController.content: As the Hebil Blue Project ("Company"), we process your personal data in accordance with the relevant legislation as a "data controller" within the scope of KVKK.

personalData.title: 2. Processed Personal Data
personalData.description: The following personal data may be collected from you through the website:
items: First name, last name
Phone number
Email address
Message/communication content
Site usage data (IP address, information obtained through cookies)

processingPurposes.title: 3. Purposes of Processing Personal Data
processingPurposes.description: Your collected personal data is processed for the following purposes:
items: Responding to communication requests
Providing information about the project and promotional activities
Improving service quality and enhancing user experience
Fulfilling legal obligations

dataTransfer.title: 4. Data Transfer
dataTransfer.description: Your personal data may be shared, limited only to the above purposes;
items: With our business partners from whom we receive services
With authorized public institutions and organizations
With domestic servers and service providers when necessary

collectionMethod.title: 5. Data Collection Method and Legal Basis
collectionMethod.description: Your personal data is collected electronically through forms on the website;
items: Based on your explicit consent,
Directly related to the establishment or performance of a contract,
Within the scope of the Company's legitimate interests

rights.title: 6. Your Rights Under KVKK
rights.description: According to Article 11 of KVKK, you have the following rights:
items: Learning whether your personal data is processed
Requesting information if it has been processed
Learning the purpose of processing and whether it is used for its intended purpose
Knowing the third parties to whom it is transferred domestically or abroad
Requesting correction of incomplete or incorrectly processed data
Requesting deletion or destruction in accordance with KVKK
Objecting to the emergence of a result against you through analysis solely by automatic systems
Requesting compensation for damages suffered
